claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held in March 2026.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another was directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
One Battle After Another stars Leonardo DiCaprio.
One Battle After Another is a comedy-drama.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won six total Oscars at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for Hamnet at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners won four awards at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners was directed by Ryan Coogler.
Bugonia, F1, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, Sinners, and Train Dreams were other nominees at the 98th Academy Awards.
